name: Map Existing Airtable Enrichment Fields to Postgres
purpose: Map the existing Airtable enrichment fields to the Postgres clients_master schema without changing the enrichment logic.

mapping.rule: Preserve semantic meaning and existing enrichment values.

rules: Do not redesign the enrichment logic.
Do not silently drop existing enrichment fields.
Do not invent destination fields.
Document fields that have no direct Postgres equivalent.
validation: Every existing enrichment field is mapped or explicitly marked unresolved.
Existing enrichment values remain semantically equivalent.

source_gap.action: Create the real field-by-field mapping from the existing workflow and clients_master schema.

name: Replace Airtable Node With Postgres
purpose: Replace the Airtable enrichment persistence operation with the equivalent Postgres operation.
rules: Preserve the existing enrichment operation.
Use the field mapping from 3.2.1.1.
Do not change unrelated workflow logic.
Do not delete the Airtable node until parity is verified.
validation: Postgres receives the same logical enrichment data.
Insert/update behavior matches the previous operation.

name: Field-by-Field Enrichment Parity Test
purpose: Verify that the Postgres enrichment implementation preserves the behavior and data of the existing Airtable implementation.
pass_conditions: All required fields have equivalent destination mapping.
No enrichment field is unintentionally lost.

name: Postgres Lead Dedup Lookup
purpose: Look up existing leads in Postgres using email, phone, and domain identifiers.
rules: Normalize identifiers before comparison where existing schema requires it.
Do not treat missing identifiers as matches.
Return existing lead information for downstream dedup logic.

source_gap.action: Use the actual clients_master identifier columns and indexes.

name: Fuzzy Match Lead by Name and Domain
purpose: Identify probable duplicates using name and domain similarity when exact identifiers are insufficient.
rules: Do not automatically merge solely on weak similarity.
Keep similarity score available for the decision node.
Do not fabricate missing values.
Use the approved similarity threshold.

source_gap.action: Configure the approved threshold before production.

name: Duplicate Decision and Merge or Insert
purpose: Route a lead to the duplicate merge/update path or the new-lead insert path.
rules: Exact identifier matches take precedence over fuzzy matching.
Do not create a second record when a confirmed duplicate exists.
Do not overwrite valid existing information unnecessarily.
Preserve the originating source channel.

name: Add lead_source_channel Column
purpose: Add the lead_source_channel field to the Postgres lead schema.
rules: Use the project's approved database migration process.
Do not drop or rename existing fields.
Choose the final database type based on the actual schema conventions.
Backwards compatibility must be preserved.
validation: New records can receive a source-channel value.

source_gap.action: Select the actual approved Postgres type before migration.

name: Set Lead Source Channel
purpose: Populate lead_source_channel using the originating lead source.
rules: Use the actual originating scraper value.
Do not overwrite the source with a generic value.
Preserve source through merge/dedup operations.
